title: Le Creuset Stoneware Mini Oval Cocotte – Red – With Lid
description:
Beautiful Le Creuset mini oval cocotte in enameled stoneware (grès), finished in the classic red color. Perfect for individual portions, gratins, desserts, or elegant serving straight from oven to table. The piece features a smooth cream interior and the Le Creuset marking on both the lid and base.
Made from high-quality stoneware, it provides even heat distribution and is ideal for oven use. The oval shape adds a refined touch and is great for presentation. It measures approximately 16 cm in length (handle to handle) and around 10–11 cm in width.
In very good condition, with light signs of use consistent with age (see photos). The interior is clean and well preserved.
A lovely and practical piece for everyday cooking, serving, or completing a Le Creuset collection.
